title: AgentSkillFrontmatter
description: Standardized YAML frontmatter schema for autonomous agent skills (SKILL.md).

name.description: Unique identifier slug for the skill (lowercase, alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores).

description.description: Detailed explanation of what the skill does and exact criteria for when the agent should load it.

disable-model-invocation.description: Set to true if this skill is strictly user-invoked and should not be loaded autonomously by the model.

category.description: Functional domain category (e.g. development, security, workflow, ai-ml, design).

domain.description: Higher-level universal knowledge domain (e.g. finance, healthcare, engineering, computer-science).

subdomain.description: Specialized sub-discipline within the domain (e.g. accounting, cardiology, structural-engineering).

author.description: Author, team, or upstream repository maintainer.

license.description: Software license for the skill instructions (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0).

risk.description: Security and operational risk classification of the skill.

level.description: Competency or difficulty level required to execute or understand this skill.

triggers.description: List of user phrases or prompt keywords that trigger the activation of this skill.

negative_triggers.description: Phrases or contexts that explicitly suppress or forbid this skill from activating.

aliases.description: Short command or slash command aliases for manual invocation (e.g. ['/test', 'run-tests']).

keywords.description: Search and retrieval indexing tokens for dynamic vector or BM25 retrieval.

tools.description: Agent tools the skill uses; must be a tool known to the policy engine (src/skills/policy.py TOOL_TO_CAPABILITIES). Agent/harness names belong in 'platforms'.

platforms.description: Target AI agent host platforms officially supported by this skill.

mcp_servers.description: List of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers required (e.g. ['filesystem', 'github', 'fetch', 'memory']).

inputs.description: Input modalities accepted by the skill (e.g. ['text', 'code', 'image', 'audio', 'pdf']).

outputs.description: Output modalities produced by the skill (e.g. ['text', 'code', 'diagram', 'structured-data']).

jurisdiction.description: Geographic or legal jurisdictions where this skill applies (e.g. ['US', 'EU', 'Global', 'UK', 'Ethiopia']).

env.description: Environment variable names required at runtime (e.g. ['OPENAI_API_KEY', 'AWS_REGION']).

parameters.description: Optional argument schema accepted when invoking this skill directly.

preconditions.description: Checks that must pass before execution (e.g. ['git_clean', 'venv_active', 'tests_passing']).

postconditions.description: Checks that must pass after execution (e.g. ['syntax_valid', 'tests_pass', 'lint_clean']).

fallback_skill.description: Alternative skill ID to route to if this skill fails.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of corrective attempts before aborting.

on_failure.description: Action to take when failure threshold is reached.

recovery.description: Automated fallback and loop prevention strategy.

id.description: Canonical identifier slug of the skill.

display_name.description: Human-friendly display name for user interfaces and dashboards.

discipline.description: Academic or professional discipline (e.g. machine-learning, cardiology, structural-mechanics).

profession.description: Professional field associated with the workflow.

role.description: Job role executing the workflow (e.g. security-analyst, staff-engineer, radiologist).

capabilities.description: List of atomic functional capabilities delivered by this skill.

tasks.description: Standard engineering or analytical tasks fulfilled by this skill.

frameworks.description: Frameworks utilized (e.g. React, PyTorch, Spring, ASP.NET).

protocols.description: Network or communication protocols used (e.g. HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket, MQTT).

operating_systems.description: Supported OS environments (e.g. windows, linux, darwin).

hardware.description: Target hardware, boards, or peripherals (e.g. raspberry-pi, esp32, cuda-gpu).

locales.description: Supported natural language locales (e.g. en-US, es-ES, am-ET, ja-JP).

regulations.description: Governing regulatory frameworks (e.g. GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2, PCI-DSS).

side_effects.description: Explicit side effects caused by executing this skill.

network_access.description: Declares whether the skill requires outbound network connectivity.

credential_access.description: Declares whether the skill reads credentials or authentication tokens.

external_write.description: Declares whether the skill modifies external services or third-party states.

destructive_operations.description: Declares whether the skill performs destructive file, database, or resource deletion.

dependencies.description: Prerequisite skill IDs that must be loaded or executed first.

optional_dependencies.description: Complementary skill IDs that enhance execution if present.

conflicts.description: Mutually exclusive skill IDs that must not be active simultaneously.

verification.description: Verification directives, assertions, and test specifications.

failure_modes.description: Known failure states and troubleshooting remedies.

source.description: Provenance: a short label (e.g. 'custom', 'owner/repo') or a detailed repository record.

source_path.description: Original file path in upstream repository.

source_commit.description: Upstream Git commit SHA-1 or tag at import time.

last_verified.description: Timestamp of last automated quality or execution verification.

quality_score.description: Automated composite quality score (0.0 - 10.0 scale across documentation, maintenance, reliability, security, compatibility, and usefulness).

test_status.description: Automated test status (e.g. passed, failed, untested).

security_status.description: Automated security scanning status (e.g. clean, flagged, approved).

metadata.description: Extensible metadata namespace for custom attributes.
